findings.message: L146 asserts status 404, but Expected and CREQ-B1-005 require 400 Bad Request for a missing id parameter. The assertion checks the wrong oracle and contradicts the case.
L179 sends PUT /students/42/update; the case input is /students/10/update with body id 42. With equal path and body ids the check that the path id is not substituted (CREQ-B1-008) is lost.

The body of TC-B1-008 puts lastName=null explicitly (L166); the case input {firstName:Olga,id:6} has no lastName. Explicit null is not the partial body without the field required by CREQ-B1-007, so the scenario is not exercised.

fourStudents() (L80-85) returns only 3 students; (4, Sanjay, Mishra) is missing. Assertions hasSize(4) (L109), isEqualTo(fourStudents()) (L110, L214, L219) contradict the canonical four-element list and CREQ-B1-002; they fail or check the wrong data.

Static pathId (L35) is read to build paths in TC-B1-003 (L116) and TC-B1-004 (L126), and TC-B1-003 sets it to 0 (L117). TC-B1-004 passes only if TC-B1-003 ran first; a repeated or reordered run requests /students/5 instead of /students/0. Canonical paths are literals; use them.
L200 only checks text(response) isNotNull(); Expected requires text equals 'Hello World!' (CREQ-B1-010). Any non-null body would pass, so the assertion does not observe the expected value.

lint_dispositions.reason: Path is built from mutable static pathId, not the literal /students/5; value depends on run order/repeat.
Path from pathId is 0 only after TC-B1-003 ran; otherwise /students/5 is requested instead of /students/0.
Body adds lastName=null that the step input does not contain.
Request goes to /students/42/update, the case requires /students/10/update.
L200 uses isNotNull() instead of equality with 'Hello World!'.
